description: This file defines macros and inline functions for handling byte order conversions for big-endian architectures in the Linux kernel.

methods.name: __cpu_to_le64p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 64-bit value from CPU to little-endian format.

methods.name: __le64_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a little-endian 64-bit value to CPU format.

methods.name: __cpu_to_le32p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 32-bit value from CPU to little-endian format.

methods.name: __le32_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a little-endian 32-bit value to CPU format.

methods.name: __cpu_to_le16p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 16-bit value from CPU to little-endian format.

methods.name: __le16_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a little-endian 16-bit value to CPU format.

methods.name: __cpu_to_be64p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 64-bit value from CPU to big-endian format.

methods.name: __be64_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a big-endian 64-bit value to CPU format.

methods.name: __cpu_to_be32p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 32-bit value from CPU to big-endian format.

methods.name: __be32_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a big-endian 32-bit value to CPU format.

methods.name: __cpu_to_be16p
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a 16-bit value from CPU to big-endian format.

methods.name: __be16_to_cpup
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a big-endian 16-bit value to CPU format.
